Anthropic Imposes Rules on User Behavior Towards Claude AI

AI company Anthropic has implemented a ban on users exhibiting "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" towards its AI chatbot, Claude. The company has not yet specified what constitutes abusive or cruel content. Concurrently, Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5, the third model in its Claude 5.5 series, which offers faster responses, more affordable pricing, and effort controls. This expansion of its AI lineup comes ahead of a planned IPO.
